visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a large metal steamer basket filled with rows of green, flower-patterned rice cakes resting on white paper. A dense cloud of white steam rises from the center. (2) A person's hands hold a green rice cake, stretching it apart to reveal a savory filling of shredded radish and small pieces of meat. The background is a blurry green outdoor setting. (3) A middle-aged man with short grey hair and a dark grey long-sleeved shirt is seen in a brightly lit indoor workspace. He uses his hands to press green dough into a red rectangular mold on a table. (4) The camera shifts to show the man placing a tray of shaped cakes onto a large industrial steamer sitting over a boiling pot in a market-like setting. (5) A wide shot shows the large metal steamer lid being lifted, releasing a massive plume of steam that obscures the stall's background. (6) Close-up shots feature various cakes being split open, showcasing different fillings: dark red bean paste, golden peanut bits, and creamy taro mash. (7) A single rice cake is shown individually packaged in clear plastic with a white turtle logo. (8) A hand reaches into a pink box decorated with cupcakes, pulling out a packaged cake. (9) The final scene shows the owner working at the stall under a pink sign, with the market's narrow alley visible in the background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 隱藏在市場裡的. (2) [Subtitle]: 古早味草仔粿. (3) [Subtitle]: 老闆使用野生鼠麴草加純米. (4) [Subtitle]: 以傳統古法製作. (5) [Subtitle]: 每天新鮮現蒸. (6) [Subtitle]: 喜歡純皮口感就選擇沒包餡的. (7) [Subtitle]: 另外還有提供5種滿滿餡料的口味. (8) [Subtitle]: 每一個都扎實軟Q. (9) [Subtitle]: 一定要吃香氣濃郁的手炒蘿蔔絲. (10) [Subtitle]: 鹹芋頭很綿密滋味清香. (11) [Subtitle]: 這個是加薑和咖哩的鹹綠豆. (12) [Subtitle]: 愛吃甜就試試濃郁甜花生. (13) [Subtitle]: 還有微甜不膩的紅豆口味. (14) [Subtitle]: 草仔粿可以單買一個. (15) [Subtitle]: 也可以購買10入盒裝. (16) [Subtitle]: 想吃古早味點心快去買吧. [Slogan]: 正港小烏龜鼠麴草仔粿 高雄市三民區新民路152巷14-1號(新生市場內). (17) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (18) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.

It emphasizes the craftsmanship using wild herbs and pure rice, showcases various sweet and savory fillings through appetizing close-ups, and provides location details to drive foot traffic.
